name: ak:worktree
overview: Create, inspect, and clean isolated git worktrees. Use for feature isolation, worktree health audits, stale cleanup, and monorepo or submodule workflows.
whenToUse: Invoke for isolated worktrees, stale cleanup, or worktree audits.

flags.name: --checkout-submodules
flags.desc: Run `git submodule update --init --checkout --recursive` in the new worktree after create

flags.name: --no-prefix
flags.desc: Skip branch prefix and preserve original case and slashes (for Jira keys, multi-segment branches like `user/type/feature`)

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.desc: Inspect worktree health, normalized paths, and base-branch divergence

subcommands.name: baseBranch
subcommands.desc: Branch the worktree is based on

subcommands.name: checkoutSubmodules
subcommands.desc: Whether create will initialize submodules after checkout

subcommands.name: currentWorktree
subcommands.desc: Current worktree health record from status --json

subcommands.name: worktrees
subcommands.desc: Normalized worktree records from list --json or status --json

subcommands.name: worktreePath
subcommands.desc: Absolute path to the created worktree
